note: A2A x402 Extension: brings crypto payments to Google's Agent-to-Agent protocol. Active repo (151 forks, 173 open issues, discussions on). Has schemes/ dir defining exact-payment settle schemes (scheme_exact_lightning, _spark, _uma) — Nano (XNO) NOT among them. The operators here DEFINE how A2A agents pay each other; a scheme_exact_nano.md would add a feeless settle rail to the A2A protocol itself.
